# Felix Keuya Renewable Energy and Project Finance Analyst

Felix Keuya provides fixed-scope and white-label analyst support to renewable energy developers, investors, lenders, advisory firms, EPCs and energy platforms across Africa and emerging markets.

Canonical website: https://felix-keuya-portfolio.vercel.app/
Location: Nairobi, Kenya
Contact: felixkeuya@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/felix-keuya/

## Core services

- Renewable energy project finance analysis: https://felix-keuya-portfolio.vercel.app/services/renewable-energy-project-finance-africa.html
  - Project screening, financial model review, debt sizing, CFADS, DSCR, LLCR, PLCR, PPA analysis, sensitivities, lender-style risk review and investment decision support.
- Solar PV and BESS financial modelling: https://felix-keuya-portfolio.vercel.app/services/solar-bess-financial-modelling.html
  - Revenue, CAPEX/OPEX, storage assumptions, debt schedules, reserve accounts, repayment profiles, IRR and downside cases.
- PPA and wheeling financial analysis: https://felix-keuya-portfolio.vercel.app/services/ppa-wheeling-analysis-africa.html
  - Tariffs, network charges, losses, residual supply, buyer savings, generator returns and curtailment analysis.
- Renewable energy market due diligence: https://felix-keuya-portfolio.vercel.app/services/renewable-energy-market-due-diligence-africa.html
  - Regulation, tariffs, demand, grid constraints, offtaker risk, procurement, project pipelines and financing conditions.
- White-label renewable energy analyst support: https://felix-keuya-portfolio.vercel.app/services/white-label-energy-analyst-support.html
  - Confidential models, research, investment memos, project screening, databases and presentations for client teams.

## Public financial model library

## Positioning

Felix Keuya combines an engineering foundation with project finance, commercial diligence and power-market analysis. The portfolio is intended for renewable energy developers, infrastructure investors, lenders, advisers, specialist consultancies and energy platforms that need practical project finance or analyst support.
